headline: A Lebanon town's grief in the aftermath of a deadly Israeli airstrike
context: More than 3,700 people in Lebanon have died in the war between Israel and Hezbollah. In a village in southern Lebanon, one airstrike last month killed 14 people, including 10 women and children.
